metadata.description: SLF IMIS automatic stations and manual study plots (daily snow depth), and the 11 GCOS sites (biweekly manual SWE, periodic). Codes are SLF-IMIS-<id>, SLF-SP-<id> and SLF-GCOS-<id>; slf_station_id holds SLF's own id.

properties.name: Engstligenalp
properties.notes: SLF IMIS automatic stations, DOI 10.16904/envidat.406, licence CC-BY-4.0. Credit WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF (www.slf.ch) with a link to www.slf.ch.

data_variables.name: HS
data_variables.description: Total depth of snow on the ground.
data_variables.notes: gcos: at the snow pit (biweekly); new_snow: fixed stake (daily); study_plot: manual morning reading (daily); imis: ultrasonic sensor — daily = median over the last 24 h, sub_hourly = 30-min instantaneous. Negative values are nulled.

data_variables.name: HN_1D
data_variables.description: Depth of new snow over the last 24 hours.
data_variables.notes: Manual board measurement at study plots; at IMIS stations it is MODELLED by SNOWPACK, not measured.

data_variables.name: TA_30MIN_MEAN
data_variables.description: Air temperature, mean over the last 30 minutes.
data_variables.notes: IMIS only, interval 'sub_hourly'.

properties.measurement_method: automatic (ultrasonic snow depth); HN_1D modelled by SNOWPACK
